title: Warning Against Forgetting the Lord
description: Moses warns Israel not to forget the Lord when they enter the good land he promised their fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—a land with cities, houses, wells, and vineyards that they did not build or plant themselves. They are to fear and serve the Lord alone, swear by his name, and not follow other gods, for the Lord is a jealous God whose anger can flare up against them. They must also not put him to the test as they did at Massah.
